struct Reading { label: Str, values: Vec<Int> }

fn sort(v: Vec<Int>) -> Vec<Int> {
    let mut sorted = v.clone()
    for i in range(0, sorted.len()) {
        for j in range(i + 1, sorted.len()) {
            if sorted.get(i) > sorted.get(j) {
                let temp = sorted.get(i)
                sorted.set(i, sorted.get(j))
                sorted.set(j, temp)
            }
        }
    }
    sorted
}
